#                                        NXVAULT
**NXVAULT is an advanced player vault plugin built for modern servers. It features a high-quality GUI, paged storage, permission-based limits, in-vault search (including inside shulker boxes), and deep configurability without sacrificing performance.​**

# Advanced GUI Vaults
**Smooth, responsive GUI with page support and clean navigation.​**
![a](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/4f8d0d83b0c2d4a5a5e8a0f861861b728d2e0f89/68747470733a2f2f66696c65732e636174626f782e6d6f652f71376a6e76682e676966)
# Deep Search System
Search items globally, including contents inside shulker boxes.
![b](https://proxy.spigotmc.org/c2a7233dba6561e7c6e18c3a75724bc00d99602a/68747470733a2f2f66696c65732e636174626f782e6d6f652f396d3539726a2e676966)
# Highly Configurable
**Customize layouts, limits, permissions, sounds, and behaviors.**
# Performance Focused
**Designed to run efficiently even on large survival servers.**
